Gallery.subtitle: A visual journey through my pictorial works.

Projects.collabsText: I have participated in exhibitions in collaboration with institutions, galleries, and private spaces, bringing my work into corporate and cultural environments where art fulfills an integrative and expressive role.
Projects.featuredText: In 2023, I was summoned by the Century 21 firm to develop exclusive pieces for its corporate spaces and showcases. This project combined the brand's visual identity with my artistic aesthetic, exploring texture, color and movement in unique compositions that reflect professionalism and creativity.
Projects.feature1: Design of artworks adapted to the architecture of the space.
Projects.feature2: Collaboration with brand design and communication teams.
Projects.feature3: Integration of contemporary art into corporate environments.
Projects.featuredQuote: "Each piece was conceived as a bridge between artistic emotion and corporate visual narrative."
Projects.inviteTitle: Discover my most outstanding room settings
Projects.inviteText: Explore how the works transform each space, integrating harmoniously with the architecture, light and style of each environment.
Projects.pressDescription: A curated selection of interviews, events, and media features that showcase how my work engages whith broader cultural conversations. Highlighted include coverage in Infobae and collaborations with Espacio & Confort.
Projects.workshopDescription: In a corporate environment that values innovation and creative thinking, this experience invites teams to engage in a unique abstract art session designed specifically for workplace groups. The workshop seeks to stimulate or unlock individual creativity, fostering new dynamics of interaction and strengthening interpersonal relationships within a playful, reflective, and professional setting.
Projects.eventsArtDescription: Live art experiences that invite participants to engage in guided creative exploration. No prior experience is required—only the willingness to discover new creative possibilities. all materials are included.

Ceramic.title: Ceramics
Ceramic.p1: Alongside painting and abstraction, I explore ceramics as a space of transformation, where earth, fire, and touch converge.
Ceramic.p2: Each piece carries its own rhythm and presence, weaving itself into the broader language of my work. In clay, I find both permanence and fragility — the beauty of what endures and the quiet poetry of what may breaks.

Gallery.title: Explore my pictorial universe
Gallery.p: Each artwork invites you to pause, observe, and let yourself be carried by color, material, and emotion. Step into the gallery and discover the original paintings that bring each project to life.

collab.title: Collaborative works
collab.description: I have collaborated with institutions and companies such as the Avon Foundation, Century 21 and Vonharv, weaving art in spaces of dialogue and transformation. Through workshops and seminars, I invite you to awaken creativity, to rediscover the language of intuition and the silent courage of expression.

workshop.title: Matter and process
workshop.p1: From my studio in City Bell, I move between materials as one moves between memories, allowing each to find its own form and rhythm. Creation, for me, is a process that unfolds between composition and chance, between control and surrender.
workshop.p2: Recycling becomes not only an aesthetic choice but a poetic act, fragments of the past reborn, matter that remembers its purpose once again.

About.subtitle: Visual artist and designer
About.title: About me
About.paragraph1: I was born in La Plata, Argentina, and I specialize in abstract art. I graduated as a Visual Communication Designer from the Faculty of Fine Arts at the National University of La Plata. I also completed part of my secondary studies in Germany, where my connection with art began. Since 1998, I have continued my training in painting, drawing, and printmaking alongside renowned artists and university professors.
About.paragraph2: My work explores the relationship between color, texture, and emotion, in a process where matter becomes language. Through abstract expressionism, I seek to create a dialogue with the viewer, inviting them to freely interpret each piece.
